programs = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_spans = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_spans.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_spans = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_spans.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    cells = [grid[r][c] for ra, rb in row_spans for ca, cb in col_spans
             for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb)]
    base = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    signal = next(v for v, _ in Counter(cells).most_common() if v != base)
    out = [[base for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for i, (ra, rb) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for j, (ca, cb) in enumerate(col_spans):
            for r in range(ra, rb):
                for c in range(ca, cb):
                    if grid[r][c] != signal:
                        continue
                    if ((r + 1 < rb and grid[r + 1][c] == signal) or
                        (c + 1 < cb and grid[r][c + 1] == signal)):
                        out[i][j] = 1
                        break
                if out[i][j] == 1:
                    break
    return out
'''
